Every way to take donations with CHAMP

Fourteen ways to put a CHAMP campaign in front of donors, each set up for real. Open any one to see it working, how it was set up, and the code to copy.

pages.html:
← All CHAMP Donate integrations
On your website

▁ Sticky bar

A slim bar slides up as visitors scroll.

Best for

Stories, news and appeal updates.

Example campaign

Willowmere – Remembrance Sunflowers (Realistic)
Created in CHAMP → Campaign → Integration as “JLM demo – Sticky bar”, so every gift from here is tracked separately.

See it in action

Scroll down. A slim bar slides up as you go.

“The garden was the first thing she saw each morning”

When Mam came to Willowmere, the first thing she noticed was the garden. The nurses wheeled her bed to the window every morning so she could see the flowers.

Over those weeks, the team cared for all of us: Mam, Dad, my brothers and me. They answered our questions at 3am, made endless cups of tea, and helped us say the things we needed to say.

Every summer since, we have planted a sunflower in the Willowmere remembrance field. It is our way of saying thank you, and of keeping her close.

Care like this is only possible because of people who give. Every gift funds nurses, family support and the quiet moments that matter most.

This year, more families than ever need that care. Your support means no family has to face the end of life alone.

Thank you for reading our story. If it moved you, please consider giving today.

pages.title: Amounts in your text
pages.html:
← All CHAMP Donate integrations
On your website

€ Amounts in your text

Amounts in your copy open the form with that amount chosen.

Best for

Copy that already talks about what a gift does.

Example campaign

Winter Coat Drive (Realistic)
Created in CHAMP → Campaign → Integration as “JLM demo – Amounts in your text”, so every gift from here is tracked separately.

See it in action

Wrap a child in warmth this winter

Hundreds of children we support start winter without a proper coat. You can change that today.

€20 buys a hat, scarf and gloves set to keep the cold out on the walk to school.

€40 buys a brand-new winter coat, chosen by the child, in their favourite colour.

€150 kits out a whole family for winter, with coats, boots and warm layers for everyone.

Click any highlighted amount: the form opens with that amount already chosen.

How to set it up

  • In CHAMP, open the campaign and go to the Integration tab.
  • Choose Amounts in your text, give it a name and click Save as new.
  • Copy the snippet and paste it once into your website (in WordPress: a Custom HTML block, or the Text tab of the classic editor).
  • Wrap each amount in your text in <span data-champ-donate="40">…</span>.
  • Publish the campaign in CHAMP so the form loads for visitors.

The code from CHAMP

<span data-champ-donate="40">€40 buys a brand-new winter coat</span>

<script src="https://giving.pmsvault.com/embed/donate-widget.v2.js"></script>
<script>
ChampDonate.init({
  url: 'https://giving.pmsvault.com/DEMO/c/winter-coat-drive-realistic?embed=true&overlay=true&utm_source=integration&utm_medium=widget&utm_campaign=rk3jth3p',
  mode: 'content'
});
</script>

pages.title: Your own Donate buttons
pages.html:
← All CHAMP Donate integrations
On your website

🔘 Your own Donate buttons

The Donate buttons already on your site open the form.

Best for

Sites that already have Donate buttons.

Example campaign

Willowmere – Garden Walk 2026 (Realistic)
Created in CHAMP → Campaign → Integration as “JLM demo – Your own Donate buttons”, so every gift from here is tracked separately.

See it in action

These are ordinary buttons on this page. Each has the class champ-donate, so clicking one opens the Garden Walk 2026 form over the page.

Sponsor a walkerDonate

How to set it up

  • In CHAMP, open the campaign and go to the Integration tab.
  • Choose Your own Donate buttons, give it a name and click Save as new.
  • Copy the snippet and paste it once into your website (in WordPress: a Custom HTML block, or the Text tab of the classic editor).
  • Add class="champ-donate" to the Donate buttons or links you already have.
  • Publish the campaign in CHAMP so the form loads for visitors.

The code from CHAMP

<a href="https://giving.pmsvault.com/DEMO/c/willowmere-garden-walk-2026-realistic" class="champ-donate">Donate</a>

<script src="https://giving.pmsvault.com/embed/donate-widget.v2.js"></script>
<script>
ChampDonate.init({
  url: 'https://giving.pmsvault.com/DEMO/c/willowmere-garden-walk-2026-realistic?embed=true&overlay=true&utm_source=integration&utm_medium=widget&utm_campaign=5bq3svqz',
  mode: 'anchor',

← All CHAMP Donate integrations
On your website

🔔 Ask for an email on close

If a visitor closes the form without giving, it asks for their email.

Best for

Recovering donors who nearly gave.

Example campaign

A Home for Every Family (Realistic)
Created in CHAMP → Campaign → Integration as “JLM demo – Ask for an email on close”, so every gift from here is tracked separately.

See it in action

A Donate button sits in the bottom corner of this page. Open the form, then close it without giving: you are asked for your email so the charity can send a gentle reminder.

How to set it up

  • In CHAMP, open the campaign and go to the Integration tab.
  • Choose Ask for an email on close, give it a name and click Save as new.
  • Copy the snippet and paste it once into your website (in WordPress: a Custom HTML block, or the Text tab of the classic editor).
  • Publish the campaign in CHAMP so the form loads for visitors.

The code from CHAMP

<script src="https://giving.pmsvault.com/embed/donate-widget.v2.js"></script>
<script>
ChampDonate.init({
  url: 'https://giving.pmsvault.com/DEMO/c/a-home-for-every-family-realistic?embed=true&overlay=true&utm_source=integration&utm_medium=widget&utm_campaign=9f6hymfz',

  frequencyCapDays: 7,
  exitIntent: { enabled: true, headline: 'Before you go...', body: 'Leave your email and we’ll send you a gentle reminder to complete your donation.' }
